items.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: I went to Chicago first and joined Billy Lussick's band. Tommy Dossier was in the band

ctx.x: When you left, who did you play with first when you left the city? Did you come north and join a band up here?

Yeah, I went to Chicago first and joined Billy Lussick's band. Tommy Dossier was in the band and Shimmer and Greg, of course Ray was in the band too. And I went back to New Orleans and I came back to Chicago for a month or so and then I went to New York. And then, well, I played around and then I joined Ben Pollock's band.
Can I ask Ray a little bit about when you played with Ben Pollock? Did he just use a stick to the director or what did he do?
